facts.fact: Statistics Botswana's Vital Statistics Report 2024 describes the Births and Deaths Registration System (BDRS) as a partially automated and decentralized system, introduced in 2003 and run through 35 district registration offices and 17 on-site registration points.

systems.owner: Department of Civil and National Registration, Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs
systems.tiers: 35 district offices; 17 on-site registration points at health facilities

systems.owner: Department of Civil and National Registration

note: Share of births registered in 2024 is about 84 percent, below 90, so no coverage fact; the report does not state whether deaths are registered in the digital system in service.
